text: I withdraw this acceptance: the final concrete checks were newly composed diagnostics, not checks present at the site commit. The published multiplication and bounded-exponential examples, their generators and resolvent formulas are valid evidence. However, the [roadmap](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/4f7a4021c5eefb6a254dcd4db450663a5f1aa71d/TauCetiRoadmap/OneParameterSemigroups/README.md#L158) also requires the resolvent identity and bound on those examples. The successful local applications do not fulfill [AI-REVIEWS step 4](https://github.com/CBirkbeck/tauceti-reviewed-by-test/blob/main/AI-REVIEWS.md#steps)’s source-presence requirement. The theorem still matches the mathematical reference; this is an evidence gap, not a counterexample.
